item.author: Brandon Sanderson
item.description: Waxillium Ladrian investiga la posible existencia de unos brazales capaces de conceder poderes extraordinarios. Junto a sus compañeros, sigue una pista que lo aleja de Elendel y revela amenazas ligadas al pasado de Scadrial y a sus conflictos políticos.

en.description: Waxillium Ladrian investigates legendary metalminds said to grant extraordinary powers. Following the trail beyond Elendel with his companions, he encounters threats connected to Scadrial's forgotten past and the political tensions shaping its future.
en.title: The Bands of Mourning
